item.title: Lykmachos #1444 the Hollow's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the F
item.description: Lykmachos #1444 the Hollow's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Lykmachos has drunk from Lethe 4 times and remembers little.

item.description: Glaukphon #8601 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
